compute_squared_error_weights: compute squared error robust loss weights for a PyTorch tensor of residuals
compute_huber_weights: compute Huber robust loss weights for a PyTorch tensor of residuals with k=1.345
compute_tukey_weights: compute Tukey robust loss weights for a PyTorch tensor of residuals with configurable threshold
review_squared_error: review the squared_error function which returns uniform weights for all residuals
review_huber: review the huber function which downweights large residuals beyond threshold k=1.345
